name: Drop Dead Gorgeous
source:
You’ve finally landed a good job working for the government. Your assignment: to monitor Patient Zero of a zombie virus. But everything changes when you instantly fall in love with the zombie. As you try to get to know them, your rich and stylish boss is also attempting to build a relationship with you.

The question is: who will you choose?

[From [url=https://mr-sean-bean.itch.io/drop-dead-gorgeous]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于找到了一份为政府工作的好工作。你的任务：监视僵尸病毒的零号病人。但当你立刻爱上僵尸时，一切都会改变。当你试图了解他们时，你富有而时尚的老板也在试图与你建立关系。

问题是：你会选择谁？

[来自[url=https://mr-sean-bean.itch.io/drop-dead-gorgeous]Itch.io[/url]]
